lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular distribution of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs across the lateral flank, with visible clusters forming a grid-like pattern in the central and posterior-ventral regions of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, although these features are heavily masked by dynamic caustic light patterns from the water surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge running across the upper mid-section of the flank, defined by a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal side and darker shadow pixels on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, vertical linear mark resembling a healed scrape or incision is visible in the central region of the flank, cutting through the spot pattern.
